title: Vendor Analytics — Top Products
description: Powers the Top products table. Filtered by calendar year only. Default year is the current year.

endpoint.auth: Vendor Bearer token + Application-Token (same as other /api/vendor/* routes)

query.year: YYYY. Required. Calendar year. Frontend defaults to the current year.

fields.products: Top products by completed-order revenue in that year. Sorted by revenue descending. Empty array if none.

product_item.name: Product display name.
product_item.units: Units sold in completed orders that year. Integer.
product_item.revenue: Gross sales from those units. Number, not a formatted string.
product_item.trend: Percent change in revenue vs the previous calendar year. Positive = up. New products with no prior year sales can send 100.
